headline: AI Stocks Gain After Anthropic Filing Rekindles Spending Confidence
summary: CoreWeave and other artificial intelligence shares gained as details from Anthropic's IPO registration reassured investors about sustained capital expenditures across the sector.
why: AI infrastructure providers depend heavily on continuous multi-billion-dollar investments by foundation model developers.

impacts.name: Semiconductors and AI Hardware
impacts.why: Proof of sustained customer spending eases concerns over slowing artificial intelligence capital outlays.

why_moved: AI-related equities rebounded after Anthropic's public filing signaled sustained demand for computing infrastructure and cloud capacity.
